全能参考｜双阶段同分辨率二采
总采样仍为 10 步，不增加总步数。
阶段1：前 4 步，电影 LoRA 0.3。
阶段2：后 6 步，电影 LoRA 0.5，DisableNoise 续采。
不做 Latent 放大，优先兼顾速度与真实电影质感。

本版修复重点：
• 第二阶段不同 LoRA 强度完全保留，不改任何 LoRA 数值
• 第二阶段 denoised_output 继续作为 Latent 放大的输入
• 放大后的 latent 不再使用 DisableNoise + 非零低 sigma 续采
• 改为 RandomNoise + 独立低 denoise Scheduler（4步 / 0.10）
• 第三阶段修复模型沿用第二阶段 LoRA 模型链
• 第三阶段只负责视频修复；音频直接锁定第二阶段原音频

目的：解决 clean latent 与 sigma 不匹配导致的人物重绘、油腻和降噪不充分感。

DY.subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man whose visual identity comes from <Picture 1>, preserving his fair complexion, grey-green eyes, tousled thick dark-brown hair falling naturally across his forehead, youthful facial proportions, defined jawline, straight nose, and subtle facial stubble.
<Subject 2> is the young woman whose visual identity comes from <Picture 2>, preserving her fair lightly freckled complexion, blue-grey eyes, light-brown hair tied loosely behind her head, long face-framing strands, softly arched eyebrows, delicate facial proportions, and natural understated makeup.

summary:
[reference generation] The target fifteen-second cinematic video places <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> on a railway platform at cold blue hour. Their restrained English farewell progresses from reluctance and regret toward quiet acceptance as an arriving train forces them to release each other.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - his recognizable facial identity, grey-green eyes, tousled dark-brown hair, youthful proportions, jawline, nose, complexion, and subtle stubble remain consistent while his clothing is naturally adapted to the cold railway-platform setting.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - her recognizable facial identity, blue-grey eyes, freckles, tied-back light-brown hair, loose face-framing strands, eyebrows, complexion, and delicate proportions remain consistent while her clothing is naturally adapted to the cold railway-platform setting.

detailed_description:
The target video uses restrained live-action romantic-drama cinematography with cool blue-hour ambience, warm practical station lights, subtle 35mm film grain, shallow depth of field, and natural facial micro-expressions.

[Shot 1] A long-lens wide shot establishes a nearly empty outdoor railway platform at dusk. <Subject 1>, wearing a charcoal wool coat over a dark knit shirt and carrying a small travel bag, stands near the open train doors on the right side of the composition. <Subject 2>, wearing a pale cream coat and a muted burgundy scarf, faces him several steps away on the left. Passengers move between them in soft focus while wind lifts <Subject 2>'s loose hair strands and moves the hem of <Subject 1>'s coat. Neither immediately approaches. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the station clock continues counting down behind them.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to a restrained medium two-shot from the side. The departing train remains behind <Subject 1>, while <Subject 2> stands close enough to touch him but keeps her hands around the end of her scarf. She looks at the open train door and then back into his eyes. <Subject 2> (S1), speaking in a soft young female voice with a slight tremble and a measured pace, says: <d>[English] I thought we'd have more time.</d> She attempts a smile, but it fades before fully forming.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>. Warm train light crosses one side of his face while the rest remains in cool evening shadow. His eyes lower, his jaw tightens briefly, and he gives a quiet breath through his nose. <Subject 1> (S2), speaking in a low young male voice with restrained regret, replies: <d>[English] We did. We just spent it being afraid.</d> His gaze returns to her, carrying apology without asking for forgiveness.

[Shot 4] At 00:09.500, the camera cuts to an intimate close-up of <Subject 2>. Her blue-grey eyes become moist, but no tear falls. A passing traveler briefly obscures the frame; when the traveler clears, her expression has softened. <Subject 2> (S1) says with a steadier voice and the beginning of acceptance: <d>[English] Then let's not be afraid of goodbye.</d> She gives him a small, genuine smile.

[Shot 5] At 00:12.500, the camera cuts back to a long-lens medium-wide shot. <Subject 1> reaches forward, and their fingertips meet briefly rather than forming an embrace. The train departure signal sounds. <Subject 2> gently releases his hand first. <Subject 1> steps backward into the train while maintaining eye contact. The doors begin closing between them. End at exactly 00:15.000 with both characters giving the same restrained, accepting smile through the narrowing doorway. Natural anatomy, stable identities, accurate English lip synchronization, no exaggerated crying, no dramatic embrace, no subtitles, no visible generated text, 16:9.

overall_soundscape:
Cold platform wind, distant station announcements, rolling suitcases, footsteps, low passenger chatter, and the quiet mechanical hum of the waiting train continue beneath the dialogue. The departure signal sounds once near the end, followed by the soft pneumatic movement of the closing doors.

non_diegetic_music:
Sparse solo-piano notes at a slow tempo begin after the first line. A sustained low cello enters beneath the man's response, then gradually softens as the train doors close without reaching a dramatic crescendo.

[reference generation, keyframe completion] 8秒奢华假日风短视频，以<Picture 1>中女性的外貌与游艇场景为参考，展现她在海风吹拂下举杯端庄浅笑的优雅画面，台词自信迷人，全程不出现字幕。

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>: fully_preserved，保留<Subject 1>的面部结构、短发、粉色百褶连衣裙、亮片高跟鞋及阳光游艇甲板背景。
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved，整体造型在镜头推近与举杯动作中保持高度一致。

detailed_description:
阳光明媚的自然光质感，浅景深让后方蔚蓝海面化为璀璨波光。海风吹拂她的短发与粉色裙摆，裙摆随微风飘逸，游艇伴随轻微海浪起伏，氛围高级、时尚且松弛。全片不出现任何字幕。

[Shot 1] 画面从<Subject 1>坐在游艇沙发上的全身景开始，手持摄影机缓慢向她推近。海风拂过，裙摆与颈巾飘逸。<Subject 1>优雅伸出手拿起沙发的香槟杯，抬眼看向镜头，(S1)微笑着低语：[Chinese]阳光，海风……还有这刚刚好的微醺。

[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, 镜头切为面部与半身近景并带极其缓慢的环绕。阳光照亮她精致的五官，<Subject 1>轻轻举杯向镜头致意，唇角微扬，(S1)接着说：[Chinese] Cheers, 为此刻的美好。 抿了一口香槟后，她优雅凝视镜头，画面在波光粼粼的惬意氛围中结束。

overall_soundscape:
轻柔的海浪拍打船体声、微风吹过衣襟与发丝的拂动声、香槟杯被拿起时的轻微碰撞声，以及贴近耳边的清晰说话声。
